en: never final nor foolproof
context: Such an exercise is never final nor foolproof, but it is necessary in order to identify what should be done
meaning: 从来不是一次定终身的，也不可能万无一失
current_zh: 这样的工作从来不会一劳永逸，也不会万无一失，但仍然不可或缺
suggest: 一劳永逸……万无一失
note: 现译已用两个成语，final=一劳永逸、foolproof=万无一失，意思准确，保留。

en: with a bit of skilful window-dressing
context: Now most predictions are borne out (with a bit of skilful window-dressing) if we extend the time period long enough.
meaning: 稍加粉饰、装点门面
current_zh: 几乎任何预言都可以通过一点巧妙装饰而被说成已经“应验”
suggest: 再巧妙地粉饰一下
note: window-dressing 正是“粉饰/装门面”，比“装饰”贴切；整句挖苦见 irony 表。

en: wrong on all counts
context: His prediction was the basis for immediate tactics of insurrection in the years 1927-31. In that light, he was wrong on all counts.
meaning: 每一条都错了（on all counts 原是法律用语：各项指控）
current_zh: 从这个意义上看，他在所有方面都错了
suggest: 条条都错
note: “条条都错”最贴 on all counts；“一无是处”太重，不用。

en: a verbal reflex of the tactics
context: they were a verbal reflex of the tactics pursued by the Russian leadership for purposes that could not be divulged
meaning: 对俄国领导层策略在口头上的条件反射
current_zh: 而只是用言辞呼应俄国领导层的策略
suggest: 只是对俄国领导层策略的口头条件反射
alt: 只是对……策略的随声附和
note: reflex 是“条件反射”，带被动、不经思考之意，比“呼应”更有贬义，合原意；“随声附和”也可。

en: galvanizing a class into independent action
context: The programme deteriorated into public relations work among a heterogeneous population, instead of galvanizing a class into independent action which would discipline the party through its experience.
meaning: 像电击一样唤起一个阶级独立行动
current_zh: 而不是去激发一个阶级的独立行动
suggest: 唤起一个阶级独立行动
note: 现译可用。

en: the water in which the Communist fish swim
context: The people become no more than the water in which the Communist fish swim.
meaning: 化用毛泽东的“鱼水”比喻（游击队是鱼，人民是水），反用以示人民沦为工具
current_zh: 人民于是只剩下一个形象：他们是共产党这条鱼游动其间的水。
suggest: 人民不过是共产党这条鱼赖以游动的水
note: 典故须让中文读者认出“鱼水”；现译“只剩下一个形象”是增译，删去。讽刺义另见 irony 表。

en: how are the educators to be educated?
context: But how are the educators to be educated?
meaning: 化用马克思《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》第三条“教育者本人一定是受教育的”
current_zh: 可问题在于，教育者自己又由谁来教育？
suggest: 可教育者本人又由谁来教育？
note: 典故，现译可用，完整版可注明出处；“可问题在于”可简化。

en: If Marx turned Hegel on his head
context: If Marx turned Hegel on his head, Stalin and Mao reversed Marx’s posture.
meaning: 典故：马克思说黑格尔辩证法“是倒立着的”，必须把它倒过来
current_zh: 如果说马克思曾经把黑格尔倒转过来，那么斯大林和毛又把马克思倒了回去。
suggest: 如果说马克思把倒立的黑格尔颠倒了过来，那么斯大林和毛又把马克思颠倒了回去
note: 《资本论》第二版跋通行中译作“辩证法在黑格尔手中……是倒立着的。必须把它倒过来”，用“倒立”可让读者认出典故；posture 意为姿势。

en: at best a side issue
context: the class struggle in the Marxist sense (between workers and employers, poor peasants and landlords) is not the basis of the seizure of State power, it is at best a side issue.
meaning: 至多只是枝节问题
current_zh: 它至多只是一个旁支问题
suggest: 至多只是个枝节问题
note: “旁支”是宗族用语，不贴；side issue 即“枝节问题”。

en: the scrabble of political fragments
context: the scrabble of political fragments has completely eliminated the social structure.
meaning: 政治碎片之间手忙脚乱的争抢扒拉
current_zh: 在这些零散政治力量的争斗中，社会结构已被完全抹去。
suggest: 政治碎片你争我夺，社会结构早被挤得无影无踪
alt: 在政治碎片的一阵乱扒中，社会结构被抹得一干二净
note: scrabble 是乱扒、乱抢，意象难完全保留；“你争我夺”取其义。现译“零散政治力量”把 fragments（碎片）坐实了，可保留“碎片”。

en: The case does not stand serious examination.
context: The case does not stand serious examination.
meaning: 这个论证经不住认真推敲
current_zh: 这种说法经不起认真检验。
suggest: 这种说法经不起推敲
note: “经不起推敲”正对 does not stand examination，自然，不加判断。

en: to block further examination, to seal off the case
context: The terms, “military-feudal imperialism”, “colonial and semi-colonial” are there to block further examination, to seal off the case from questions as to why the Russian bourgeoisie showed this curiously different response to the Chinese.
meaning: 堵住追问，把问题封死
current_zh: 这类词，是用来堵住进一步追问的，仿佛可以把问题封闭起来，不再让人追问
suggest: 是用来堵住追问、把问题封死的
note: 现译“仿佛可以”是增译，原文没有“仿佛”；“堵嘴”过口语，只作备选。

en: In the beginning was the Word
context: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word—the correct Marxist-Leninist line—was with the Communist party, or, in certain circumstances, with Mao alone.
meaning: 《约翰福音》1:1“太初有道，道与神同在”
current_zh: 太初有道，而这个“道”，也就是正确的马克思列宁主义路线，与共产党同在
suggest: 太初有道，道……与共产党同在
note: 用和合本译文，读者可认出经文；保持“道与……同在”句式。讽刺见 irony 表。

en: become the prey of other alien forces
context: All the problems are in the area of doctrine, arising from those who misinterpret or neglect the doctrine and thereby become the prey of other alien forces.
meaning: 沦为异己力量捕食的对象
current_zh: 他们因此成为其他异己力量的猎物
suggest: 沦为其他异己力量的猎物
note: 现译可用；“沦为”比“成为”更合 become the prey 的贬义。

en: the guillotine cut swathes through the rich
context: In the Terror, the guillotine cut swathes through the rich to feed and clothe the poor
meaning: 像割庄稼一样成片砍倒富人
current_zh: 在恐怖统治时期，断头台成批斩落富人的头颅，为穷人争取衣食。
suggest: 断头台在富人中成片砍杀
note: 现译可用；cut swathes 是割麦割草的意象，“成片”可保留。

en: to disturb the sleep of the rich of Europe for decades to come
context: establishing an image of revolution to disturb the sleep of the rich of Europe for decades to come.
meaning: 让欧洲富人几十年都睡不安稳
current_zh: 这一革命形象，让欧洲富人在此后几十年里寝食难安。
suggest: 让欧洲富人此后几十年都睡不安稳
note: “寝食难安”多出“食”，但属通用说法；“睡不安稳”更贴字面。两者均可。

en: the backbone of which was the PLA
context: In the same way, the mass organizations of China in 1966-7 were absorbed into Revolutionary Committees, the backbone of which was the PLA
meaning: 以人民解放军为骨干
current_zh: 而革命委员会的骨架是人民解放军
suggest: 以人民解放军为骨干
note: “骨架”是硬译；中文说“骨干”。

en: grounded his final views in the bedrock of reality
context: years of warfare and struggle grounded his final views in the bedrock of reality—the supreme need for accumulation.
meaning: 使他的最终看法落在现实的坚硬底子上
current_zh: 但多年的战争和斗争终究使他的最终看法扎根在现实的基岩上
suggest: 使他的最终看法落到了现实的硬底子上
note: “基岩”生硬；bedrock 意象可用“硬底子/地基”。

en: sporadically attacking the symptoms of inequality
context: That determined the approach of tolerating the real inequality of income generated by the need for accumulation while sporadically attacking the symptoms of inequality.
meaning: 时不时打击不平等的表面症状，不触及根源
current_zh: 同时又时不时攻击不平等的表征
suggest: 时不时拿不平等的表象开刀
note: symptoms 是医学比喻；“治标不治本”意思吻合，但下了判断（作者只说攻击症状），放备选。“表征”偏学术。

en: Through the trappings of Marxist jargon
context: Through the trappings of Marxist argon, the essentials of nineteenth-century radical nationalism reappeared to justify the role of a new class.
meaning: 借马克思主义术语的外表装饰
current_zh: 在马克思主义术语的外衣下
suggest: 披着马克思主义术语的外衣
note: trappings 是外表装饰；“外衣”贴切。原文 argon 系 PDF 抽取错（jargon）。

en: The Chinese revolution was not “betrayed”.
context: The Chinese revolution was not “betrayed”.
meaning: 暗指托洛茨基《被背叛的革命》（The Revolution Betrayed）一类说法
current_zh: 中国革命并没有“被背叛”。
suggest: 中国革命并没有“被背叛”
note: 典故，现译可保留；完整版可加注说明呼应托洛茨基书名，便于读者理解引号。

en: the first had entirely swallowed the second
context: By Mao’s time, the distinction between national and international liberation had been entirely lost; indeed, the first had entirely swallowed the second.
meaning: 前者把后者整个吞没
current_zh: 事实上，前者已经整个吞掉了后者
suggest: 前者已把后者整个吞没
note: 现译可用。

en: Mao settled for
context: Mao settled for the twentieth century’s version of the “bourgeois revolution”, for the “emancipation of the productive forces”.
meaning: 退而求其次，接受了一个较低的目标
current_zh: 毛最终接受的是二十世纪版本的“资产阶级革命”
suggest: 毛退而求其次，选择了二十世纪版的“资产阶级革命”
note: settle for = 退而求其次，现译“最终接受”丢了这层；“退而求其次”分毫不差。

en: a far cry from
context: that meant full State ownership of the means of production, planning and the militarization of society—a far cry from what was appropriate in France in the late eighteenth century.
meaning: 与……相差很远
current_zh: 这同十八世纪末法国所需要的东西相距甚远。
suggest: 相去甚远
note: a far cry 对“相去甚远”，现译“相距甚远”亦可。

en: were swept along
context: The backward countries, including China, were swept along, albeit at a relatively declining pace.
meaning: 被潮流卷着往前走
current_zh: 落后国家，包括中国，会被一并卷向前方，只是相对速度越来越慢。
suggest: 被潮流裹挟着向前
note: swept along 是被水流卷走；“裹挟”贴切。
